---
title: "Model Statistics"
subtitle: "Performance metrics for all pre-built pairwise models"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(rePredRet)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

# Statistics are computed from the published model index, so they are always current
index <- tryCatch(rePredRet_models(), error = function(e) NULL)
has_data <- !is.null(index) && nrow(index) > 0

# Log axes with plain-number labels at 1, 3, 10, 30... (0.03 instead of 3e-02)
log_breaks <- c(1, 3) * rep(10^(-4:6), each = 2)
plain_labels <- function(b) vapply(b, format, "", scientific = FALSE, drop0trailing = TRUE)
scale_x_log <- function(...) scale_x_log10(breaks = log_breaks, labels = plain_labels, ...)
scale_y_log <- function(...) scale_y_log10(breaks = log_breaks, labels = plain_labels, ...)
```

All statistics are per model, computed at the calibration compounds of each model:

- **Median error**: median absolute difference between fitted and measured RT
- **Median PI width**: median width of the 95% prediction interval over the RT range

## Summary

```{r summary-table}
#| echo: false
if (has_data) {
  summary_stats <- data.frame(
    Statistic = c("Total Models", "Total Systems", "Calibration Points",
                  "Median Compounds/Model", "Median Error (min)", "Median PI Width (min)"),
    Value = c(
      format(nrow(index), big.mark = ","),
      length(unique(c(index$sys1_id, index$sys2_id))),
      format(sum(index$n_compounds), big.mark = ","),
      median(index$n_compounds),
      round(median(index$median_error), 3),
      round(median(index$median_ci_width), 3)
    )
  )
  kable(summary_stats, align = "lr")
} else {
  cat("The model index could not be loaded.")
}
```

## Error Distribution

```{r error-hist}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
#| echo: false
if (has_data) {
  ggplot(index, aes(x = median_error)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = median(index$median_error), color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_x_log() +
    labs(
      x = "Median Absolute Error (min, log scale)",
      y = "Number of Models",
      title = "Distribution of Median Absolute Errors",
      subtitle = sprintf("Median over all models: %.3f min", median(index$median_error))
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14)
}
```

## Prediction Interval Width Distribution

```{r ci-hist}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
#| echo: false
if (has_data) {
  ggplot(index, aes(x = median_ci_width)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = median(index$median_ci_width), color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_x_log() +
    labs(
      x = "Median 95% PI Width (min, log scale)",
      y = "Number of Models",
      title = "Distribution of Median Prediction Interval Widths",
      subtitle = sprintf("Median over all models: %.3f min", median(index$median_ci_width))
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14)
}
```

## Model Quality vs Number of Compounds

```{r compounds-vs-error}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
#| echo: false
if (has_data) {
  ggplot(index, aes(x = n_compounds, y = median_error)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.05, size = 0.5, color = "steelblue") +
    geom_smooth(method = "gam", formula = y ~ s(x, bs = "cs"), se = TRUE, color = "red") +
    scale_x_log() +
    scale_y_log() +
    labs(
      x = "Number of Calibration Compounds (log scale)",
      y = "Median Absolute Error (min, log scale)",
      title = "Prediction Error vs Model Size"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14)
}
```

```{r compounds-vs-ci}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
#| echo: false
if (has_data) {
  ggplot(index, aes(x = n_compounds, y = median_ci_width)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.05, size = 0.5, color = "steelblue") +
    geom_smooth(method = "gam", formula = y ~ s(x, bs = "cs"), se = TRUE, color = "red") +
    scale_x_log() +
    scale_y_log() +
    labs(
      x = "Number of Calibration Compounds (log scale)",
      y = "Median 95% PI Width (min, log scale)",
      title = "Prediction Interval Width vs Model Size"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14)
}
```

## Largest Models

```{r model-table}
#| echo: false
if (has_data) {
  model_display <- index %>%
    select(sys1_id, sys2_id, n_compounds, median_error, median_ci_width) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_compounds)) %>%
    head(100)

  kable(model_display,
        digits = c(0, 0, 0, 3, 3),
        col.names = c("From", "To", "N", "Error (min)", "PI Width (min)"),
        caption = "Top 100 models by number of calibration compounds")
}
```
